rows.text: Under Article 25(2) and Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer (or Article 18 person) chooses one of procedures (a), (b) or (c): (a) module B followed by module C, (b) module H, or (c) module G.

rows.text: Under Annex III point 1.3.8.1 (and Annex I point 1.3.8.1), guards for moving transmission parts must be interlocking movable guards rather than fixed guards where frequent access is envisaged.

rows.text: Essential health and safety requirement 1.3.7 of Annex III addresses risks of contact from moving parts that could lead to accidents, including where risks persist, risks of contact and psychological stress in human-machine interaction and coexistence, and accidental blockage of moving parts (with safe unblocking where blockage is likely).

rows.text: Under Article 18 of the Regulation, the natural or legal person who carries out a substantial modification is considered the manufacturer for purposes of this Regulation.

rows.text: Machinery placed on the market must be accompanied by the EC declaration of conformity (DIR, Art. 5(1)) and by instructions in the official Community language(s) of the Member State where it is placed on the market and/or put into service (DIR, Annex I, 1.7.4).

The manufacturer must keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the machinery or related product is placed on the market or put into service (Regulation, Art. 10(3)).
